$Comment: A dungeon skill lock, the rubble heap (Excavation's): a full block of the game's gravel (Soil_Gravel's texture), so a heap of them chokes a passage. Using it does nothing on its own, so the use reaches the room's trigger volume, whose ZigRequires opens it for a player with the skill and whose RejectionEffects tell anyone else what opens it (the SkillLock room template, tools/rooms). It has no Gathering, so no survival player, creature or explosion can break it and it drops nothing; it has no recipe and no category and is a Variant, so the creative library hides it. It needs no support, so it never falls as loose gravel would.
